its the uncanny valley instinct, something that despite as much as the super-ego/ego tries to rationalize and scrub away with "morality", exists there and was a necessity to evolve for a very good reason. Something that looks human but has something that deviates from it triggers a threat response because of the necessity to be on alert for the spread of disease, or a foreign invader who may harbor no familial bonds of "tribe" and sees you either as a resource to be exploited or competition to removed. However with the cognitive disconnect with the veil of "fiction" placed overtop a setting, a person will be much more honest with their feelings and their responses to observations, since they feel that it is not real and therefore won't be judged for it either internally or externally.
